اختصرن (form VIII)
# اِخْتَصَرْنَ (iḵtaṣarna) /ix.ta.sˤar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
# اُخْتُصِرْنَ (uḵtuṣirna) /ux.tu.sˤir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
# اِخْتَصِرْنَ (iḵtaṣirna) /ix.ta.sˤir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
